translations.web: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
translations.bsb: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
translations.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
translations.asv: He that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal; that he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
